title: Total DNA Extraction from Plant Tissue Using CTAB Method
author: Robert Auber
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bamnic5e

steps.title: Grind Plant Tissue
steps.instruction: Grind 1-5g of frozen plant tissue into a fine powder using a pre-chilled mortar and pestle.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells in CTAB Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 ul of pre-heated 2 x CTAB buffer (containing beta-mercaptoethanol) to the pelleted cells.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend by gently pipetting up and down

steps.title: Incubate Sample
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 60 °C for 30 minutes, mixing gently periodically.

steps.title: Perform Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol Extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to the sample.

substeps.instruction: Mix very well at room temperature (RT) for 5 min to generate a monophasic solution
Centrifuge for 10 min at 5,000 x g
Transfer the aqueous phase (upper layer) to a new tube

steps.title: Optional Repeat Extraction
steps.instruction: If the interface is not clean, repeat the chloroform:isoamyl alcohol extraction and centrifugation steps.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with Isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 2/3 volumes of isopropanol to the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Mix gently for 5 min at RT
Centrifuge for 15 min at 10,000 x g

steps.title: Wash and Resuspend DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet and resuspend it in TE Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 uL of 70% ethanol to the pellet and briefly vortex to dislodge it
Air dry the pellet for 30 min

steps.title: RNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Add DNase-free RNase to a final concentration of 1 ug/mL and incubate at 37°C for 30 min.

steps.title: Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract the DNA using an equal volume of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1).

substeps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a clean tube

steps.title: Final DNA Precipitation and Purification
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA using ammonium acetate and ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1/3 volume of 7.5 M ammonium acetate and 2.5 volumes of 100% ethanol
Air dry for 30 min at RT
Resuspend in 50 ul of TE Buffer
Allow the DNA to dissolve overnight at 4°C
